source_policy: Original supplied archive/member bytes remain untouched. This owner review does not activate Splicery stage/gate registries as Writfold authority or edit the sibling implementation.

ownership.splicery: Language semantics, frontend, normalized IR, pure checked edit kernel and their own qualifications.
ownership.writfold: Ordinary capability discovery, authenticated scope, run/worktree/Worktrunk bindings, prepared-edit admission, durable claims, grants/predecessors/resource generations, native materialization, receipts and reconciliation.
ownership.weft: Its own logical/report interpretation. A report is not edit permission; a selected admitted procedure may require a precisely bound report without imposing a universal proof floor.

decisions.transport: Reuse ordinary initialized shared stdio. Logical open/select/prepare/apply/reconcile names in the handover remain proposals, not registered methods. Current control-only capabilities are unchanged.
decisions.worktree_profile: A run-owned dirty/generated/untracked regular-file capture needs a separately admitted worktree profile. It is not an immutable Git-blob citation or corpus admission; preserve realm/run/repository/worktree/binding/capture/profile/metadata identity.
decisions.subjects: Weft report, knowledge citation explaining why, exact worktree selection identifying where, source recipe, resolved IR, prepared edit, candidate bytes and effect are distinct typed subjects.
decisions.replay: Recipe-attributed host receipts require independent replay of exact source/lowering/read-set over authorized immutable input through the pinned shared Splicery kernel. Client digests alone do not establish derivation; future IR-only inputs must be labeled separately.
decisions.identity: Review and register distinct canonical domains and vectors for recipe/capture/candidate/prepared-edit/request/effect material before a writer. Existing canonical framing and semantic intent versus dispatch stamps remain controlling; output equality is not intent equality.
decisions.idempotency: Authenticated principal/realm/run/request key binds one immutable intent and original effect/outcome. Conflicting intent refuses, including byte ABA. Lost replies and expired prepared material do not reopen a dispatched key.
decisions.materialization: Private or cooperating run-owned worktrees; contained descriptors, regular/singly-linked files and explicit metadata policy. Check exact raw preimage and ownership under reservation; qualified absence/no-clobber mechanisms for create/rename; no auto-parent creation or cross-device copy/delete fallback.
decisions.outcomes: Visibility, durability and durable acknowledgement are separate. Post-install sync failure and uncertain claimed writes retain Unknown/partial observations and reservations, never a fabricated no-effect rejection or blind replay. Multi-file operations retain per-file outcomes and applied prefix, not fictional global rollback.
decisions.disclosure: Preview/diff truncation never changes candidate identity. Access checks precede content/count diagnostics. Historical handles retain exact meaning or expire; stale anchors never retarget silently.
decisions.policy: No new generic VM, second writer, mutable sibling dependency, automatic Weft-report authority, CIT07/V23 floor or storage fallback.

requirements.subject: Run-owned worktree acquisition, separate profile and exact aliases
Pinned compiler/kernel replay, normalized intent and host-created prepared edit
Durable claim, current authority, expected heads, request-key history and reconciliation
Exact effect receipts and read-only Run Watch projections

required_adverse_cases: wrong realm/run/worktree/binding/profile or foreign same-text capture
formatter or metadata change between prepare and apply gives stale refusal
cross-image keep, partial match sets or overlapping original destinations refuse
same request key and changed intent conflicts after byte ABA
lost acknowledgement resolves the original effect without redispatch
post-rename fsync error is uncertain durability, not rejected/no-effect
create/rename destination race never overwrites a competing file
cancelled or unknown claimed write retains reservation until qualified quiescence/reconciliation
partial multi-file success never reports rollback or whole-batch completion
unauthorized original text/counts never appear in diffs/diagnostics

sibling_implementation_review.scope: Read-only sibling assessment and actual retained-preview execution; no Splicery source edits, fresh Lean/Verus gate run, release promotion or Writfold edit admission.
sibling_implementation_review.contract_note: The Writfold control-only stdio artifact exists; it does not provide the still-missing worktree data/effect methods.

qualification.storage_dependency: Omnigraph P01O/WF24 remains blocked. The authorized disposable Dolt integration profile has separate DINT prerequisites; neither its native foundation nor the sibling offline preview closes authoritative ledger/native-effect requirements.
